title: Remuneration Cap for Key Management Staff of Fifth Schedule Companies like GIC and Temasek Holdings
what_it_is: Remuneration Cap for Key Management Staff of Fifth Schedule Companies like GIC and Temasek Holdings

sections.label: Staff remuneration set by boards
sections.summary: Staff remuneration is decided independently by the boards, with the Government at arms-length and frameworks based on performance and benchmarks.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The remunerations of their staff are, therefore, decided independently by their respective boards.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Government maintains an arms-length relationship with the companies and does not interfere in their operational decisions, such as remuneration.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Broadly speaking, both entities adopt remuneration frameworks that are based on performance and industry benchmarks.

sections.label: Long-term performance and returns
sections.summary: Part of remuneration is tied to long-term performance, and the Government evaluates the entities on long-term returns net of expenses.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: A portion of the remuneration in both entities is tied to long-term performance.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Ultimately, the Government evaluates the performance of the two entities based on their long-term returns, net of all expenses incurred.

sections.label: System supporting GIC and Temasek mandate
sections.summary: The aim is to design a system that best supports GIC's and Temasek's mandate of securing good long-term returns on their overall portfolio.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: As I have said, what we are trying to do is to design a system that best supports the mandate of GIC and Temasek, and that mandate is to secure good long-term returns on their overall portfolio.

sections.label: Expected long-term return assessment
sections.summary: The expected long-term return is proposed to the President, who assesses it with the Council of Presidential Advisers, and annual performances are published.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The expected long-term returns for both GIC and Temasek, that figure is proposed to the President and the President makes an independent assessment of that long-term expected return, together with the Council of Presidential Advisers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, that long-term expected return is the basis which both GIC and Temasek work to achieve over a period of time and their performances every year are published in their annual reports.
